{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Eastern_Dune_Sea.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The desert known as the Eastern Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine]]
{{Quote|The desert is a hard place, Han. It allows no room for mistakes.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Darksaber">''[[Darksaber (novel)|Darksaber]]''</ref>}}
'''Deserts''' were regions on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with very low amounts of precipitation. Deserts were classified by lack of precipitation, not specifically heat as desert landscapes were hot due to proximity of nearby [[Star/Legends|stars]] or simply arid because it was too cold to precipitate.

Deserts were large expanses of bare ground with little [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetation]] or [[Plant/Legends|plant]] cover. Harsh and dry, deserts were ecosystems in which both plant and animals were capable of surviving for long periods without [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and [[Water/Legends|water]]. Deserts could be of varied terrain but were mainly rocky or sandy and characterized by infertile land and a lack of rain. [[Temperature/Legends|Temperatures]] in desert areas were typically hot during the day and cold at night since they were not affected by humidity. Truly cold deserts were known as tundras.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
